coordinate_comparison.scope: Model 1, entity 1, label chains A/B/C. Match local label_seq_id, residue and atom name. For each permitted chain mapping fit one rotation (det +1) and translation to the pooled trimer.
coordinate_comparison.fit_convention: Template row vectors multiplied by rotation, plus translation, map to target xyz in angstroms.
coordinate_comparison.precision: Coordinate steps describe printed decimal places. The bound assumes rounding to nearest in both input files. It is a conservative upper bound on achievable RMSD if a common rigid transform and coordinate rounding alone explain the discrepancy. It is not experimental uncertainty.
coordinate_comparison.exact_criterion: The two independently selected atom-key sets must match, and the deposited decimal coordinates must be exactly congruent by a proper isometry under at least one chain permutation. Exact congruence is tested with integer dot products and handedness; numerical tolerances only identify RMSD ties. A fit to a partial intersection cannot establish full-mask equivalence. This comparison evaluates selected coordinates. It does not evaluate individual Job endpoints, their decision thresholds, or per-input control sampling.

scope: Only observed combinations in both Runs. Delta comparisons follow deposited chain labels. GX first availability refers to the corresponding immutable target SHA in that Run.
